title: nwc → ss OIDC userinfo claim set
description: The CLOSED allow-list of claims nwc (provider, native simple_oauth /oauth/userinfo) emits to the Moodle consumer (auth_nwc_oauth2). Derived from NwcOidcClaimsServiceProvider::REQUIRED_CLAIMS. additionalProperties:false is deliberate — it is the data-minimisation gate (P74 §Phase-0 / intersite-contract research §2). Adding a claim here is a boundary change: it must go through the contract_version bump + the ss side's review. `sub` is the load-bearing UID-lock join key (= Drupal uid).

sub.description: Subject identifier = Drupal user.uid (simple_oauth default). THE UID-lock join key → mdl_user.idnumber. Must be stable and never reused (see intersite research open-question Q4).

email_verified.description: MUST be the real verification state (never hardcoded true — see F26 M1). A hardcoded true enables takeover-by-email on the Moodle side.

updated_at.description: Seconds since epoch (OIDC core) — integer, not a date string.

guilds.description: The ONE custom claim. Guild membership + per-guild role machine-names. Sole writer = nwc_oidc_claims (after the F26 flat-vs-nested collision fix). Role machine-names are a shared vocabulary across the boundary — renaming one silently changes what Moodle receives (see research §1 silent-break risks).
